mentions.name: Local History Map
mentions.description: A web app that puts local history on a map, so when users go somewhere they can immediately see cool or interesting history that happened nearby. Points of interest and stories are contributed by local historical societies, with the author building relationships with these volunteer-run organizations to source content.
mentions.problem: There is no easy way to discover interesting local history near where you are; sourcing content is also slow because many historical societies are run voluntarily by people in their 70s and older.
mentions.audience: People visiting a location who want to discover interesting history that happened close by.
mentions.source_excerpt: Want to put local history on a map, so when I go somewhere I could ideally just open this webapp and immediately get presented with cool or interesting history that happened close by.
